name: LINCS_search_signatures
description: Search LINCS SigCom drug perturbation signatures with offset pagination and pages up to 1000 records. The service has no count endpoint, so this tool uses a one-record lookahead to report reliable has_more and next_offset without presenting the current page length as a total. Returns signature IDs, doses, time points, cell lines, tissues, and disease context.

drug_name.description: Drug or perturbagen name to search for. Case-sensitive, use lowercase for best results. Examples: 'vorinostat', 'imatinib', 'dexamethasone', 'trichostatin-a'.

cell_line.description: Optional cell line filter. Examples: 'MCF7', 'A549', 'HepG2', 'PC3'. Leave empty to search all cell lines.

offset.description: Zero-based signature offset (default 0). Continue with metadata.next_offset.

name: LINCS_list_libraries
description: List and optionally keyword-filter the complete LINCS SigCom library catalog. Filtering is applied to the full catalog before exact local offset pagination; metadata reports total_libraries, exact total_matches, has_more, and next_offset.

keyword.description: Optional keyword to filter libraries (case-insensitive). Examples: 'L1000', 'kinase', 'proteomics', 'RNA-seq', 'CRISPR'. Leave empty to list all.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the filtered library list. Continue with metadata.next_offset.
